summary: Restoration pledges are to rehabilitate 33 priority sites by 2035 and increase restored native-forest area from 900 ha to 1,500 ha by 2035. The target total equals about 3.1% of current national forest cover, while the 600 ha increment equals about 1.2%; a projected 13% decline in usable water resources by 2050 without catchment action underlines this priority. Integrated conservation-and-production measures include expanding Rodrigues’ terrestrial protected-area network by at least 100 ha by 2033, increasing mangrove and seagrass coverage by 5%, reaching 50 ha of mangroves by 2030, and establishing 10 melliferous-plant corridors. Apiculture zones are to expand to 300 ha by 2035, about 2.2% of current agricultural area, while new habitat is to increase by 60%, although no base or deadline is stated. Agriculture also targets a 25% reduction in chemical fertiliser through organic and bio-based alternatives, without a specified area or deadline.
